fees._comment: Fractional rates matching funding_observations.differential_8h's units - 0.0005 means a 0.05% taker fee, NOT 0.05. Standard base-tier rates; override to your actual VIP/fee-token tier.

analysis._comment: max_holding_periods is in 8h-normalised funding periods (3 = ~24h). A position held longer amortises the fixed round-trip fee cost across more funding capture, so a thinner differential can still be profitable - see src/analysis/funding_edge.py.
